entry.summary: Not to take up the proposed merger of the Architectural Preservation District Commission and Historical Commission as part of the bylaw review, since it was not on the Special Town Meeting warrant.

entry.summary: Recommend approval of Article 14, Bituminous Concrete Common Driveways (Planning Board article, Special Town Meeting). — passed 5-0-0

entry.summary: Historical Commission motion to approve the warrant article for the merger of the APDC and Historical Commission — passed 2-1 (as heard: "Two eyes, one nay. Passes.")

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 18, 2025: Sewer Commission, 2025-10-14

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 18, 2025: Select Board, 2025-09-02
